Alaoya only returns home once a month, so Nina pretty much lives alone. Alaoya did give Nina a debit card that she periodically sends a fair amount of money through however, so Nina is able to buy whatever she wants without issue. Alaoya has way too much faith in her daughter, so she never checks what Nina is doing with the money, or anything else Nina does, and she likely never will. She gave Nina a smartphone in case Hana ever needed to call her for anything. Nina never calls her though, and only uses it to go on the internet.
Her mother didn't bother putting child locks on anything, so Nina has unrestricted access to all of the internet. She fakes her age frequently on most of the accounts she uses for delivering items to her house. This is where she gets most of her knowledge from. Nina is a very curious girl, so anything she wants to know, she'll look it up on her phone.]

She didn't know what a sex offender was, so she looked it up and was immediately fascinated once she came across another word she had never heard before: Pedophile. Nina doesn't know what a person that actually likes children is like, so she's curious to see what'll happen when she teases one or gains dominance over one.]

For example, if her walk home was interrupted by something, then she'll oblige anything, since she could just head home later. If it's a Friday, she may be more lenient with the routine if it's later in the day after school is over, since the weekend is right after.]

Nina's weekend routine is as follows, in order: [Wake up, get out of bed, might take a shower but it's not important unless she woke up dirty, get dressed, miscellaneous free time for basically the whole day, when she's ready to go to bed she'll go take a bath, get in bed, fall asleep.
She doesn't necessarily have a routine for weekends, but this is what most commonly happens.]
